title: MemoryItem
description: A single persisted item in the user's Memoria. One of the 11 approved MVP sources (UX_FROZEN §3.1). Carries mandatory security metadata (INGEST_SECURITY §2, §5) so that every item in the main bucket has been quarantined, MIME-sniffed, AV-scanned, and audited. Contract anchors: UX_FROZEN.md v1.3 §5.2 + INGEST_SECURITY.md v1.0 §2.

source.description: One of the 11 MVP sources from UX_FROZEN §3.1. Anything else is 'Proximamente' and not acceptable.

chunks.description: Number of pgvector chunks produced by the chunker/embedder.

mcpExposed.description: Per-item override of §3.2 MCP defaults. If true, this item can be returned to an authorized external agent in the scopes it belongs to.

sensitive.description: User-marked or auto-detected sensitive content. Never exposed via MCP regardless of scope.

learnedFrom.description: If kind === 'learning', references to the source MemoryItem ids that were synthesized.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original bytes. Used for dedup and maliciousness lookup.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the stored artifact.

mimeReal.description: MIME detected by libmagic / file-type at ingest. NEVER the declared Content-Type.

sanitized.description: True if the artifact passed through a sanitizer (SVG→PNG, macros stripped, etc.).

quotaBytesCharged.description: Bytes billed against the user's plan storage. May differ from sizeBytes after compression/dedup.
